sentences.text: MCRC No.42067/2023 is second and MCRC No.37640/2023 is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicants/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.33/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Crime Branch, District Indore (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 409, 420 and 34 of IPC.

2. First bail application of applicant - Rohan Sagar was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 23.08.2023 passed by this Court in MCRC No.36794/2023 with liberty to file fresh application after filing of charge-sheet.

3. Prosecution story in brief is that accused Aditya Tiwari pretending himself to be an agent of Hermes India alongwith other co-accused persons entered into a criminal conspiracy and lured the complainant Manish Sharma to provide with discount of 35% to 40% on branded company products had taken Rs.17,22,000/- from him and thereby committed cheating.

4 . Learned counsel for the applicants/accused persons submit that applicants have not committed the offence and they have falsely been implicated in the case only on the basis of memorandum statement given by co-accused Aditya Tiwari.
Applicants have not received any amount from the complainant Manish Sharma.
As alleged, only co-accused Aditya Tiwari had cheated and received Rs.17,22,000/- from the complainant in his ICICI bank account
thereafter, co-accused Aditya has deposited the aforesaid amount into the bank accounts of other co-accused persons namely, Rohan Sharma, Ajay Verma, Tarun Nagar and Dilkhush.
Present applicants - Rohan and Satish Ahirwar are in custody since 16.06.2023 and 30.07.2023 respectively.

After completion of investigation,
charge-sheet has been filed.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal therefore, it is prayed that present applicants be released on bail.
5 . On the other hand, counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of bail applications.

6. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicants deserve to be enlarged on bail hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, the applications are allowed.
7.

It is directed that applicants- Rohan Sagar & Satish Ahirwar shall be released on bail on their furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) each alongwith one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court, for their Rohan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7585334/
2 appearance before the concerned Court regularly on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during trial.

8.
This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
9. With the aforesaid, these applications are allowed and stand disposed of.
